problems: malaya: the Cliopatria row is a regional catch-all for the Malay principalities, not a state; the Wikipedia article is a disambiguation page. Wikidata Q1479726 is shared with federation-of-malaya but they are different states (1294-1351 vs 1958-1962). Kept as an aggregate with no capital and a status correction; a split into the individual principalities is recommended.

sultanate-of-brunei: judged ONE continuous state (one dynasty, 1888 protectorate and 1984 independence as rename events), not split; Cliopatria has no shape for 1890-1986, supplied as a new keyframe from the 1987 outline.

majapahit: identity.end is 1518 (Demak page, matching Cliopatria's successors from 1519), against 1527 on the Majapahit infobox and 1478 traditional; Cliopatria's Sumatran, Bornean, Malay and eastern parts are drawn as tributary tint (1350-1406) rather than direct rule, which contradicts the srivijaya dossier's Sumatra successor entry for 1294.

page budget exceeded for sultanate-of-brunei (10 pages vs 9) and malaya (5 vs 1-2) because the Malaya, Brunei_Civil_War and Charles Brooke pages held nothing useful; Bolkiah_of_Brunei did not load (use /Bolkiah).
WebFetch returns a small-model summary of each page, so quotes in notes are its extracts; no page was read in full.

tondo starts at 900 (first historical mention in the Laguna Copperplate Inscription per the infobox); Cliopatria starts 1375. The Tondo shape is cut to a 40 km circle of Manila (about 40% of the drawn area), a judgment.
